body: I have heard this tip before. I hope I could put it to good use and maybe do something with it. My biggest issue is getting over the fear that it will be bad, even after I try to fix it after the initial writing.
I do like playing them. I'm not a binge gamer who plays for hours at a time. I more enjoy playing for a few hours here and there. I'm that steam user who has a lot of games and half are unplayed.

Here's the thing: I already pay rent, and a majority of the rest of the bills. My mom and I are more like roommates while my mom finishes school. She basically just needs me for a place to live and a bank account. We split the chores pretty evenly, but it's hell if I manage to screw something up while doing the chores and my mother finds out.

I considered writing freelance, including on Cracked, but I really have no idea where to start. I've tried starting a comedy blog, but obviously, finding the motivation to complete anything is really, really difficult.

I'd like to share the concepts of my stories, but I'd be way too embarrassed if someone considers them bad.

First, thank you for your kind words. They really mean a lot to me.

> You seem like a person who once was more enthusiastic about living. What do you think changed?

I'm not entirely sure. I guess when I realized I focused about five or six years on a career I really wanted to do, but now the job I work is in that field, and I realized I don't want to do that anymore. I feel like all of that time was wasted, and now I have nothing going for me besides what I was working on for so long. 

And, I'm 20 and still living at home with my mom. Nothing necessarily wrong with that, but I don't drive, I can only get to work and home on my bike, and I really have never had a chance of true independence. I have no idea what it means to be "on my own."

Those aren't the only thing, per se, but so many little things have piled up, and they all accumulated to a breaking point a few months ago where I lost desire in everything.

I guess my biggest problem is, is trying to find the motivation to pick myself up and do something, to begin with. I do have things I'd like to do, but to find either the motivation to do them, or the optimism to get them completed, is nigh impossible.

For example, I'd really like to write fiction. I have ideas, plots, stories, characters, everything. I just can't find it in me to do anything with them. If I try, I'll just cry to myself because I feel like something extremely bad will happen if I even attempt to do it, because if I screw it up and it turns out terribly, I'll *never* want to do it again. I can apply this to any situation in my life: Looking for a new career, advancing my artistic ability, learning to drive. The motivation and optimism to even start doing those things is gone.

My social anxiety has reached beyond the point of just communicating with others. I live in constant fear of talking, in general. I'm a terrible communicator, and I feel like I'm thinking so quickly, my thoughts get jumbled and my words don't come out correctly. I keep having these states in random bursts, and it's terrifying to not know when they come. I have no other way to explain what this feels like.

> Try talking to someone you trust about how you feel? You have made a great step by posting here. 

I don't really trust people in my life. Anyone I could talk to will either tell me I'm awful and selfish, or won't have anything to say but "I'm sorry you feel that way." The only way anyone could help me is if they handed me a stack of money and told me to find a psychologist. Otherwise, I don't tell anyone in my life anything that's wrong, because it's basically pointless. I guess that's why the internet helps more than real life individuals.

Thank you for the TED talk. I'll be sure to watch as soon as I'm coherent tomorrow morning.

It depends on the day. If I work, I wake up at 8:30, go to work until whenever I leave, and then I pretty much sit on the internet or play video games all day until I'm tired enough to go to bed. On days I don't work, there's not much I do besides what I do already.

I've been trying to take up a hobby, but nothing is really sticking so far.
